title: Security & Privacy GUI v1
description: Native Surfshark-like unified GUI on 127.0.0.1:8765 with Threats, block/unblock, sortable table, persistent IP allowlist/blocklist, and preserved Privacy backend.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$patch=Join-Path $root 'patch-security-privacy-gui-v1.py';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/scripts/patch-security-privacy-gui-v1.py?ts='+[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()) -OutFile $patch -TimeoutSec 30;$py=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $py){$py=(Get-Command py.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source};& $py $patch;if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){throw 'GUI_V1_PATCH_FAILED'};Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-security-privacy-web.py*'}|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue};Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Privacy UI' -ErrorAction Stop;Start-Sleep -Seconds 3;Write-Host 'GUI_V1_RESTART=PASS'
repair: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';Write-Host 'GUI_V1_REPAIR=REAPPLY_PATCH';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$patch=Join-Path $root 'patch-security-privacy-gui-v1.py';$py=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $py){$py=(Get-Command py.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source};& $py $patch;Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-security-privacy-web.py*'}|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue};Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Privacy UI' -ErrorAction Stop;Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
rollback: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue';$dir='C:/3EN-Agent/security-privacy-stack/gui-v1-backups';$dst='C:/3EN-Agent/security-privacy-stack/3en-security-privacy-web.py';if(Test-Path $dir){$b=Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '3en-security-privacy-web-*.py'|Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending|Select-Object -First 1;if($b){Copy-Item $b.FullName $dst -Force;Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-security-privacy-web.py*'}|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue};Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Privacy UI' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;Write-Host ('GUI_V1_ROLLBACK=PASS;BACKUP='+$b.FullName)}}
